downstream_attrition_guard: The three-event universe-stage buffer is provisional capacity, not final quota satisfaction. If financing, single-asset, trial-identity, point-in-time science/capital-structure, source-conflict, or other frozen promotion controls exclude more than three of the 43 not-yet-excluded negatives, another narrow negative-only repair may be required.
selection_boundary: The repair uses only clinical/regulatory negative-event labels, pre-event security identity, frozen pre-event investability thresholds, and explicit corporate-action continuity. No stock return, MFE, MAE, swing-success, or post-event price behavior is used for selection.
